But I notice something important: there are some extra orange pixels that seem to be remnants of the X passing through areas:

- (48, 27), (48, 33) - these are where blue dots were
Wait, looking more carefully at the boxes:
- Box at [[47, 33], [47, 34], [48, 34]]: [] - empty box (was blue, now consumed)
- Box at [[48, 32], [49, 33], [49, 32]]: [] - empty box (was blue, now consumed)
So TWO blue boxes were consumed! The X collected blue dots as it passed through them. This confirms that the X collects ANY dot it passes through, not just matching-color ones.
But wait, I was trying to collect orange dots. The orange dots are at (39, 9), (42, 24), (57, 9). Let me check if any were collected:
- (39, 9): still present as an orange pixel
- (42, 24): still present as an orange pixel  
- (57, 9): still present as an orange pixel

- Box at [[38, 8], [38, 10], [40, 10], [40, 8]]: ['O'] - still has orange
- Box at [[41, 23], [41, 25], [43, 25], [43, 23]]: ['O'] - still has orange
- Box at [[56, 8], [56, 10], [58, 10], [58, 8]]: ['O'] - still has orange
So no orange dots were collected. The X passed through blue dots but not orange ones.
Now I need to figure out how to collect the orange dots. The X center is at (45, 30). The orange dots are at (39, 9), (42, 24), (57, 9).
For the X to collect a dot, the dot needs to be on one of the X's diagonals. X center at (cr, cc):
- Main diagonal: r - c = cr - cc
- Anti-diagonal: r + c = cr + cc
With X at (45, 30):
- Main: r - c = 15
- Anti: r + c = 75
Check orange dots:
- (39, 9): 39-9=30, 39+9=48 → not on either
- (42, 24): 42-24=18, 42+24=66 → not on either
- (57, 9): 57-9=48, 57+9=66 → not on either
So I need to reposition the X. I calculated earlier that center at (48, 18) would collect all three:
- Main: r - c = 48 - 18 = 30 → (39, 9): 39-9=30 ✓
- Anti: r + c = 48 + 18 = 66 → (42, 24): 42+24=66 ✓, (57, 9): 57+9=66 ✓
Current X center: (45, 30)
Target: (48, 18)
Need: DOWN 1, LEFT 4
But wait, I also need to understand: does the X collect dots as it moves past them, or does it need to be positioned exactly? In level 1, the cross collected dots when its arms passed through the boxes. Here, the X seems to collect dots when its arms overlap the box locations.
Let me move to (48, 18) and see if all three orange dots get collected.
